sourceRoot: The site project root, i.e. the parent directory of design-repo/. Every `path` below is relative to it. When that directory (identified by src/routes.js) is absent, verify_all.py prints a warning and skips citation checks instead of failing.

excludedSources.note: Never used as content, never cited, never packaged.
paths: reference/ (sibling of the site folder: the user's saved copy of the original page)
.playwright-mcp/ (sibling of the site folder: raw measurement dumps)

spotChecks.finding: CLONE_SPEC.md §4 and §13.2 say the homepage logo grid only fades in and never rotates. Current src renders the home strip with rotate: true, and the later /mail and /plans measurements record rotation.
spotChecks.resolution: Contracts follow current src: home uses the 'rotating' variant. CLONE_SPEC's statement is recorded here as superseded, not copied.

spotChecks.finding: plans.md §3.6 measures the floating-header CTA label at 14px; src uses primaryMid with the 16px text-button role and a comment saying 16/600 was measured.
tailwind.config.js declares the 'button-mid' type role but no file under src uses text-button-mid.
spotChecks.resolution: Kept in tokens/00-foundation/typography.json (it is a real declared token) and flagged in its description.

spotChecks.finding: CLONE_SPEC.md §0.3 says non-last grouped sections use padding-bottom = vp; mail.md §0.4 measures 96. Both exist in src: homepage AgentSection/PagesSection use pb-vp, PageSection always uses py-section.
spotChecks.resolution: layout.sectionGroup documents the PageSection rule; the homepage aside rows are their own sections (aside.wide / aside.pair).

spotChecks.finding: Spec component names do not always match src: StatBand, QuotePair, SplitMedia and CtaBlock are inline JSX or other components (Mail.jsx stat section, Agents.jsx TwoColumn quotes, SplitFeature, CtaBand); FeatureColumns is IconFeatureGrid; TestimonialPair is QuoteGrid.
spotChecks.resolution: Every contract's implementedBy cites the real src location, not the spec name.

spotChecks.finding: go.md §13.2 says demo videos should show a static frame under reduced motion; mail.md/docs.md measured the original autoplaying anyway. VideoSlot itself does not read the media query, but illustrations.css stops every illustration animation under reduce, and the /mail and /docs hero loops declare their keyframes only under no-preference.
spotChecks.resolution: video-viewport-gated locks reducedMotionFallback to 'static-frame'; hero-video-loop locks 'static-complete-frame' (the complete scene that is also the loop's first and last frame); hero-video-oneshot locks 'static-final-frame'. All three are what the snapshot renders.

evidence.expect: - Under reduced motion, show a static frame

spotChecks.finding: The /mail and /docs hero slots now render dedicated looping art (MailHeroLoop, DocsHeroLoop) registered under their slot ids, which win over the art fallbacks hero-video-1 / hero-video-3. Cycles: mail 35.9s, docs 28.3s (docs cursor 14.15s = half a cycle, so twice per cycle); infinite iterations; identical first and last keyframes; static under reduced motion. VideoSlot still pauses when fully out of view and resumes at >=20% visible. The homepage carousel art hero-video-1..3 is unchanged: 7s, one iteration, fill forwards.
spotChecks.resolution: New pattern hero-video-loop (hero.product-video, media.demo-video) with cycleMsBySlot; new pattern hero-video-oneshot (additional on hero.carousel, durationMs 7000). The contracts make them mutually exclusive.

spotChecks.finding: The /go pinned feature text is now a CSS scroll-driven animation: .pin-row names a view-timeline (--pin-row); .pin-text runs pin-slide (translateY -50% -> 50%, i.e. +-h/2), pin-fade-in (first 200px) and pin-fade-out (last 200px) over animation-range cover calc(50vh - 33.5px) -> cover calc(100% - 50vh - 33.5px), base opacity 0. Gated by @supports (animation-timeline: view()), min-width 640.02px and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. The JS scroll/rAF hook returns early when CSS.supports('animation-timeline: view()') is true.
spotChecks.resolution: sticky-pinned-text keeps its trigger (scroll-view-timeline), easing (linear) and fallback, and now records the mechanism (primary + JS fallback).

spotChecks.finding: Every FAQ is single-open: /go and /agents already passed `single`; /enterprise's FaqAccordion now does too.
spotChecks.resolution: faq.accordion `mode` is pinned to the single value 'single'.

spotChecks.finding: html has scroll-behavior: smooth under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; ScrollToTop passes behavior 'instant' so route changes still jump. The /plans compare button's smooth scroll to the table took about 0.79s when observed; that duration is browser-chosen.
spotChecks.resolution: Recorded as compatibility/motion-patterns.json siteWide.smoothScroll; no duration is pinned.

spotChecks.finding: Placeholder strings in CLONE_SPEC.md, specs/enterprise.md and specs/plans.md had been reworded from the original site's copy. In 1.1.0 every such string was replaced by the independently written implementation in src/data (content.js, plans.js, enterprise.js) or src/components/Banner.jsx; each spec carries a copy note saying so.
spotChecks.resolution: Copy budgets still use only the measured original lengths, which the specs keep. No spec copy is quoted in this repo; the example uses the implemented /mail copy (independently written per specs/mail.md §14).

spotChecks.finding: The /mail compatibility h2 (src/data/mail.js compat.c / compat.e) previously named two mail clients whose names could coincide with real products. They were renamed in src to the invented names Wrenmail and Driftpost.
spotChecks.resolution: The example PageSpec uses the renamed, implemented copy. Generation guidance still forbids naming real third-party products.

spotChecks.finding: site/ia.json (built by a separate IA pass after this snapshot started) also defines 7 one-route templates with the same section order. It is coarser: it folds homepage intro+aside rows into product groups, treats the /docs video and logos as one 'video-showcase', and does not list the /agents centred button row as its own section.
spotChecks.resolution: Used as corroborating evidence only; templates here derive from the page components directly.

spotChecks.finding: Sampled spec values match current src: breakpoints 640.02/1080.02/1280.02/1440.02, palette hexes (neutral-5, purple-60, green-90, mulberry-100), heading-lg clamp, elevation shadows, hero 10000ms/500ms, logo 2000ms/500ms, accordion 200ms ease, sticky-row 200px fade and 67px header offset, floating header 71/170px triggers.
